d: We are seeking proactive, results-oriented, and commercially minded professionals for the positions of Sales Executive / Business Development Executive. These roles focus on sales growth, customer acquisition, business development, market expansion, and the establishment of long-term client relationships. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong communication abilities, commercial awareness, negotiation skills, and a commitment to achieving business objectives and identifying new revenue opportunities.

Responsibilities include identifying potential customers, developing new business opportunities, generating sales leads, and promoting the company's products or services. Professionals will engage with prospective clients, understand their business requirements, prepare sales proposals, conduct product presentations, negotiate commercial terms, and support the closing of sales agreements. Additional duties include maintaining customer relationships, managing sales pipelines, monitoring market trends, researching competitors, preparing sales reports, and evaluating business development opportunities. They will also coordinate with marketing, operations, and customer service teams to ensure effective sales delivery, address client inquiries, strengthen customer engagement, and contribute to revenue growth and market positioning.
Bachelor's degree or diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Management, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of sales processes, business development, and customer relationship management.
Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Ability to identify potential customers and develop commercial opportunities.
Familiarity with CRM systems, sales tracking tools, and business reporting.
Strong commercial awareness and understanding of market trends.
Ability to prepare sales proposals, presentations, and business reports.
Excellent interpersonal, networking, and relationship-building abilities.
Strong organizational skills and a results-oriented mindset.
Ability to work collaboratively, manage competing priorities, and contribute to business growth objectives.

iCapital is looking for a VP, Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO), to join its Regulatory and Compliance team to oversee the firm’s Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF) and Counter-Proliferation Financing (CPF) framework in the United Arab Emirates. The VP, MLRO will serve as a financial crime compliance leader responsible for establishing and maintaining an effective, risk-based AML program aligned with iCapital’s UAE activities.
q: 10-15+ years of alternatives experience, preferably with private funds and registered investment advisor experience in the UAE and Middle East
Experience in fund structuring and formation, reviewing governing documents for alternative and registered funds.
AML/KYC expertise of regulatory requirements for private fund investors and distributors in EMEA
Excellent verbal communication skills and strong ability for personal interaction.
Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a continuous learning mindset.
Self-motivated with robust project management and process development skills
JD a plus, but not required
We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely on Friday.

r: Oversee the UAE AML/CFT/CPF compliance framework and ensure alignment with applicable UAE laws, regulations, and global standards.
Act as primary contact for applicable UAE regulators and the UAE Financial Intelligence Unit.
Oversee the investigation, escalation and reporting of suspicious activity in association with relevant investigations.
Monitor regulatory developments and lead implementation of enhancements to the firm UAE framework.
Review EMEA distributor agreements to ensure compliance with UAE requirements.
Serve as the primary AML contact with the iCapital Middle East Client Solutions team.
